thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — ran a Mistral/MQA perf sweep with the new paged KV layout and hybrid kernel selection. saw ~18% throughput drop on >2k token tails, wondering if this rings a bell or if i botched the config :thinking:
Sam: can you paste the numbers and the flags you used?
Alex: yeah, quick summary: 256 concurrent streams, seq_len dist skewed to long tails (~3% >2k).
Alex: perf sample: 
```
model=mistral7b-mqa variant
kernel=auto -> fallback to matmul-opt on some steps
kv_layout=paged-v2
num_key_value_heads=16 (originally)
throughput: baseline 420 tok/s -> experiment 345 tok/s
p95 latency: 210ms -> 360ms
page_miss_rate: 4.7% -> 18.9%
```
Sam: yikes, page_miss_rate jump is suspicious. is fragmentation spiking (lots of small pages)?
Jia: probable cause: head-count mapping mismatch between GQA->MQA projection and KV packing. if `num_key_value_heads` doesn't align with kernel head tiling we get wasted pages and extra copies. also check RoPE scaling — MQA sometimes uses a different rope_alpha and that can change kernel selection heuristics.
Alex: we set rope_alpha=0.5 to keep locality for long sequences, but didn't retune head alignment. kernel logs showed repeated kernel-switching: `matmul-opt` after `auto` failed a fast path.
Luis: attaching profiler snippet from the same run: 
```
KV page allocs/sec: 1200
avg_page_size: 3.2KB
page_frag_ratio: 0.42
copy_overhead_ms/sec: 28ms
kv_evictions/sec: 9
per-kv-head-load-imbalance: 1.9x
```
Luis: fragmentation high, plus head imbalance close to 2x — that maps to the 18% throughput loss.
Zara: suggestion: tune batching heuristics before reworking layout. for taily workloads try lowering `max_batch_tokens` and increasing `batch_wait_ms` so the batcher groups longer sequences more aggressively and kernel gets better occupancy. e.g. `max_batch_tokens=4096` -> 2048, `batch_wait_ms=3` -> 6. also try `--batcher=continuous` to avoid small micro-batches. :thumbsup:
Sam: operationally, can we rollback the canary? this was on a canary pool.
deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-06T14:22 rolled out to pool: inference-canary-3. Triggered by `mistral7b-mqa:paged-v2`. Rollback option available: `/deploy rollback inference-canary-3`
Sam: ok good. Jia — if we change `num_key_value_heads` what values should we try?
Jia: try aligned factors of the attention heads and tiling width. For Mistral7B (96 total heads) experiment with `num_key_value_heads=32` and `kv_align=64`. That helps pack 3 heads per page with less wasted space. Also try `merge_keys=true` to reduce page count if latency cost is acceptable.
Alex: noted. i'll rerun two quick candidates: (A) `num_key_value_heads=32, kv_align=64, merge_keys=true, kernel=matmul-opt` (B) `num_key_value_heads=24, kv_align=48, kernel=auto, batch_wait_ms=6, max_batch_tokens=2048`
Luis: for measuring, capture `page_frag_ratio`, per-head load, and kernel-switch counts. capture traces for the steps where kernel fallback happens (we want call stacks + small kernel runtime).
Zara: also try toggling `kv-paged-compact-threshold=0.25` — compaction aggressiveness reduced fragmentation on a previous run.
Alex: running A now on canary. will post perf + profiler in ~30m. thanks all. :pray:
